newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian President back in hospital.
newsitem.headline: Austrian President back in hospital.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil, struck down by an acute lung infection two months ago, was back in hospital after suffering from shortness of breath, a spokesman said on Saturday.
Klestil was readmitted on Friday afternoon after complaining of shortness of breath, whereupon doctors found droplets of blood in one of his lungs.
Klestil, 64, was first admitted to hospital on September 13 with a severe bout of pneumonia, and was released seven weeks later.
He is expected to remain in hospital until the beginning of the week, a presidential spokesman told Austrian televison.

Klestil became president in 1992 and helped restore Austria's image abroad after his predecessor Kurt Waldheim's controversial period in office. Waldheim was shunned by most foreign leaders for concealing his Nazi past.
